hooks.command: grep -qE '"(file_path|filePath)":"[^"]*mo2_mcp[^"]*tools_[^"]+\.py"' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": "Edit on an MCP tool file in mo2_mcp/.
